# Twenty provider

This is an initial scaffold, not a working or released provider. It exports provider metadata and configuration only. Authentication, resources, and data sources are not implemented.

The intended target is Twenty v2.44.0. Future work will use Metadata GraphQL at `/metadata` for IAM and configuration, not CRM records. Password-session authentication is forthcoming; the current provider makes no network requests and does not verify credentials.

## Example usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    twenty = {
      source = "glitchedmob/twenty"
    }
  }
}

# Illustrative only. The scaffold has no release, authentication, or resources.
# Build locally and use a Terraform CLI dev_overrides entry to load the binary.
# Future authentication will use TWENTY_EMAIL and TWENTY_PASSWORD.
provider "twenty" {
  endpoint = "http://localhost:3000"
}
```

This example describes the planned interface. There is no Registry release to install. Build the scaffold locally and use Terraform CLI `dev_overrides` if you need to inspect its schema.

## Configuration behavior

`TWENTY_ENDPOINT`, `TWENTY_EMAIL`, and `TWENTY_PASSWORD` provide environment fallbacks. Explicit attributes override their environment variables, including empty strings. Endpoint and email values are trimmed; password bytes are preserved. There is no default endpoint.

Use the instance base URL without a `/metadata` suffix. Prefer HTTPS outside disposable local tests. The scaffold does not validate the URL or require credentials. Schema-only configuration returns immediately without reading credential environment variables.

Do not commit passwords to Terraform files. Sensitive schema attributes redact display output but do not prevent secrets from appearing in saved plans. Inject credentials through the environment or a suitable ephemeral mechanism.

Keep the automation bootstrap identity and its own role outside Terraform management. Preserve a separate recovery administrator. Future password mode must reject interactive authentication requirements without weakening MFA, CAPTCHA, SSO, or verification settings.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `email` (String) Dedicated automation account email for forthcoming password-session authentication. May also be set with `TWENTY_EMAIL`. Explicit values override the environment. This scaffold does not authenticate.
- `endpoint` (String) Twenty instance base URL, without the `/metadata` suffix. May also be set with `TWENTY_ENDPOINT`. No default. Explicit values override the environment. This scaffold does not contact the endpoint.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Automation account password for forthcoming password-session authentication. May also be set with `TWENTY_PASSWORD`. Explicit values override the environment. Sensitive values can still appear in saved Terraform plans; inject credentials through the environment.
